create_subclass_extended_vision_dataset: create a subclass of ExtendedVisionDataset implementing get_image_data, get_target, and __len__ methods
implement_get_image_data: implement the get_image_data method in a subclass to return raw image bytes for a given index
implement_get_target: implement the get_target method in a subclass to return target labels for a given index
use_getitem_with_transforms: use __getitem__ on an ExtendedVisionDataset subclass to retrieve decoded image and target tuples with optional transforms
implement_len_method: implement the __len__ method in a subclass to return the total number of samples in the dataset
